implemented-requirements.description: User Configuration Ingestion: Accepts CLI inputs and reads user-provided YAML configuration files to determine runtime behavior for the core CLI and selected plugins
Multi-plugin Variable Handling: Manages configuration variables and secrets for all plugins that are executed
Plugin Enumeration: Detects plugins available on the local filesystem by searching a well-known or user-defined location
Plugin Execution: Executes one or more plugins as independent sub-processes and directs output to the terminal or filesystem
Plugin Generation: Automates the generation of plugin scaffolding from Gemara Control Catalogs using the `generate-plugin` command
Configurable Log Output: Allows users to adjust the verbosity and location of log outputs
Configurable Result Output: Allows users to configure the output location for runtime execution results
